hook_text: Arcads AI is changing how ads are made. [primary text]
persona_inferred: inferred: marketer or lead-gen team shooting new video ads every week
persona_evidence: "Instead of shooting new videos every week"; "Brands, agencies, lead-gen teams"; frames show a prompt box producing AI creators holding a product
visual_hook: contact sheet: Arcads-logo vertical clips of AI actors holding products, a man to camera in a small circle, and screen recordings of a prompt box (first frame seen only via contact sheet)
distinctive_assets: arcads wordmark over each AI clip; recurring man-in-circle presenter; word-by-word captions
sutherland_lens: inferred: makes the invisible production process visible by showing the prompt becoming a finished UGC-style ad, solving legibility for a marketer who doubts AI actors look real.

hook_text: As a VA, have you ever had a client who says you're "invaluable"... [primary text]
persona_inferred: inferred: experienced virtual assistant paid a flat hourly rate for years, worried AI will replace the work
persona_evidence: "As a VA"; "still pays you the same £25 an hour... three years ago"; image: 'For VAs that want more money with fewer hours'
visual_hook: two-column OLD WAY vs NEW WAY chart on brown and gold (Replaceable to Irreplaceable, £25/hr to £65-250+/hr)
distinctive_assets: brown and gold palette; 'The Operator Shift' named method
sutherland_lens: inferred: names an unlabeled problem (being relied on but not paid for) so the persona sees it, fits the VA persona well, with a status-and-price-signal shift to a priced leader role.
works: Opens with a precise scene the VA owns ('invaluable' but the same £25/hr); the image restates it as a scannable before/after; the founder story is in the first person.
weak: '2k months to 7k months in 30 days' and '1100 VAs' have no source or evidence in the ad; '£65 to £250 an hour' is a claim; very long primary text; image 'Certified' is unexplained.
adaptation_idea: Opens on a persona situation (relied on but underpaid) in the identity angle, with an old-way/new-way image and only sourced results.
